summary: The shot opens nearly still on the TV picture, then the camera pull-back starts abruptly at 146.39 and moves at a steady fast rate after that.

faults.what: The TV screen's right edge barely moves from 146.26 to 146.36, at about 285-300 px in tile coordinates. Then it jumps to about 245 px at 146.39 and keeps moving about 30 px per frame (213, 180, 153). The camera pull-back starts with a sudden lurch after a near-hold, so it reads as the cut tweening.
faults.fix: Ease the pull-back in over the first 6 to 8 frames, or start it at the cut. Alternatively, hold the framing steady until the move begins.
